transcript.text: Tankers with first tank battalion, first Marine Regiment, get a little dirty working on their
M1A1 Abrams main battle tanks. The Marines perform heavy maintenance on the tanks to prevent any
real damage resulting from the rough Afghan terrain. Their hard work is critical to keep
the vehicles rolling so they can accomplish their mission.
We've been able to do quite well. We've been able to work on the getting the parts in country
in Afghanistan to be able to fix the tanks once they've been damaged. How to keep the tanks moving,
how to keep them up. It's been best to have to be a challenge and just been keeping the tanks
operational. It's a challenge the Marines have met with great success. They know the
difficulties of maintaining the 71 ton beasts but a broken impact wrench and the long hours in the
100 degree desert don't keep these Marines from getting the job done. Reporting from Combat Outpost
